Name: Katanas and Maces Replacer
Author: Neopffe
Description:
[b][size=5]Features:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]New vanilla sprite replacement for 9 swords, 7 hammers and 3 daggers
[*]Configure in game with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[*]Main version requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*]Xnb version requires no mods but can't be configured
[/list][b][size=3]
Enabled by default:﻿[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Katana: Lava Katana, Galaxy Sword, Infinity Sword, Steel Smallsword, Dragontooth Cutlass
[*]Mace: Lead Rod, Galaxy Hammer, Infinity Hammer, The Slammer, Dragontooth Club
[*]Little Rapier: Galaxy Dagger, Infinity Dagger
[/list]
[b][size=3]Disabled by default:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Meowmere: Terra Blade
[*]Galaxy Sword: Muramasa
[*]Forest Sword: Flower katana
[*]Dwarf Sword, Dwarf Hammer, Kudgel
[/list]
Outfit on screenshots is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30605]Animated Zoologist Outfit (Fashion Sense)[/url]
Water on screenshots is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15079]Better Water 2[/url]

[b]I allow anyone to do absolutely whatever they want with my sprites, don't credit me[/b]
